mapping_json.fidelity_notes: MINION/PROXY ascendancy — PROXY_ASCENSION (Necromancer minion build); PROXY_SOVEREIGNTY candidate for the STR-stacked super-minion reading. THE SIGNATURE TWIST: The Baron helm converts a PLAYER attribute (Strength) into ARMY scaling — +1 max zombie per 500 STR, half player STR added to minions, and at 1000 STR minions leech life to the player. This lands as: (a) attribute-stacking gear-affix (§4 numeric modulation — STR-stack feeding minion-count/power is a trait/affix scaling); (b) the 1000-STR life-leech-per-minion maps to resource_economy TH (damage_taken_converts_shape=resource-fill — minion-damage-leeched-to-player). PHYSICAL RULE: zombies are physical-melee proxies -> element-neutral (element carries flavor only; Alberon's chaos-on-STR is a minor rider). ground_slam = the per-zombie slam geometry (the army's damage; player geometry is passive/irrelevant per dossier). No signature ailment called out for zombie slams (raw physical); ailments empty. The 'YOUR gear stat becomes the ARMY's scaling' identity is captured by the STR-attribute-affix + PROXY door, though the engine abstracts it as attribute-scaling-of-minions rather than a bespoke Baron-helm primitive.
